morphologyBasis.primaryReference: Wang Lin Pixel02 currently used in the game
morphologyBasis.rule: New neutral/views use live Wang Lin as Image1. Explicit action corrections may edit the same NPC and direction first, with same-direction live Wang Lin remaining the primary style/anatomy reference at the recorded input index. Own NPC pilot locks identity; every action is compared directly at native1x. One neutral scale per source; padding never enlarges anatomy.

actors.name: Trần Duy
actors.description: Middle-aged male sect guide. Compact dark bun with grey streak, short moustache and goatee, ivory-grey robe, thin bronze trim, celadon waist token and sect-tag pouch.
actors.gesture: A calm direction-giving open palm: neutral, lifts right forearm, opens hand towards actor facing/local direction, holds, retracts, exact neutral. No pointing a weapon.

actors.name: Diệp Tĩnh
actors.description: Elderly woman cultivation teacher with softly aged face and grey-salt compact bun. Ivory and smoky jade robe, small jade string and closed bamboo scroll. No beard, no young heroine face.
actors.gesture: A calm breath-teaching gesture: neutral, draws palms near abdomen, gently separates palms, holds inward palms, closes hands, exact neutral. Jade string remains attached. No visible qi or FX in body sheet.

actors.name: Tạ Kiếm Sơn
actors.description: Mature male training instructor about forty, compact dark bun, small eyebrow scar, navy robe and wrapped wrists. Holds a short worn wooden sword pointing down; never heavy armor or huge sword.
actors.gesture: A measured wooden-sword wrist demonstration: neutral sword tip down, raises forearm slowly, angles the wooden sword across waist, holds controlled guard, lowers wrist, exact neutral. Feet remain planted; no attack, slash, FX or lunge.

actors.name: Tô Nhược
actors.description: Adult woman supplies clerk. Dark compact bun, muted jade robe, ivory cloth apron, earthy-red tied ledger, small sealed wooden case and a small brush. No beard, no child face.
actors.gesture: Inspecting a sealed case: neutral, brings small case to waist, tilts case to inspect seal, taps or traces seal once with small brush, lowers case, exact neutral. Keep case small and same shape in every frame.
